scripts.name: holder
statements: SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ
SELECT d_ytd FROM district WHERE d_w_id = 1 AND d_id = 1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE district SET d_ytd = d_ytd WHERE d_w_id = 1 AND d_id = 1

scripts.name: waiter
statements: SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ
UPDATE district SET d_ytd = d_ytd WHERE d_w_id = 1 AND d_id = 1

success_criteria: Waiter sessions block on row lock for ~8-12s until holder commits
Innodb_row_lock_waits increases by >= 2 during injection window
Task completes within 14s without unbounded stalls

risk_assessment.impact: Brief stalls for any TPCC transactions touching district(1,1)
risk_assessment.deadlock_risk: Low; single-row write hotspot with serializable order
risk_assessment.data_risk: Minimal; UPDATE is a no-op on d_ytd
risk_assessment.recovery: Transactions commit and sessions exit automatically at end of duration
